pages.text: The Overworld is sheltered by the Stillness. Live Bloom cannot normally take hold here. Your home needs neither liberation nor fuel to remain sheltered.
pages.title: A field guide
A quiet world
pages.text: Look for small pale, cold traces on natural ground. Harvest this dormant tissue for flakes. It does not spread or infect. Newly explored Overworld terrain contains these traces; colonies whose blooms are gone leave the same

pages.title: A quiet world
pages.text: A one-time search places a starter trace on suitable natural land within 128 blocks of world spawn and records its location on your first visit. An ocean spawn may have no suitable ground; ordinary traces still generate farther

pages.title: From traces to instruments
pages.text: A book and a dormant flake make this journal. The assay kit also uses a raw flake rather than active essence. Neither needs a working machine.

pages.title: From traces to instruments
pages.text: Four flakes make a Dormant Knot. Build a Stillness Resonator around that knot using iron, copper and redstone, then build an Essence Condenser from ordinary materials. Place them adjacent. The sheltered knot supplies twenty

pages.title: From traces to instruments
pages.text: Resonance per tick without burning flakes. A single flake and 4000 Resonance become one essence in ten seconds. Other FE generators can supply the condenser instead.

pages.title: Your first deployment
pages.text: Make the terminal using refined essence, then complete Field Survey to open remote deployments. You do not need to defeat an Overworld boss to leave home.

pages.title: Your first deployment
pages.text: The first survey is practice with routes, checkpoints and extraction. The hostile frontier is elsewhere. Other dimensions still require preparation, repeated successful expeditions and their own bound guardian to become safe

pages.title: Your first deployment
pages.text: The terminal needs glass rather than amethyst. Complete Field Survey to learn checkpoints, then Trace Recovery to learn carrying bound cargo back to extraction. Together these establish the home campaign and open Deep Salvage;
Your discoveries belong to you. A replacement book remembers them.
